senses.gloss: † धि धि, i. 6, Par. To hold (akin to धा).
ऽधि -धि (vb. धा, form of an old ptcple., धन्त्, cf. ऊधन्, पयोधस् and पयोधि), latter part of comp. nouns, The receptacle for keeping that which the preceding part denotes; cf. e. g. अम्बु-धि.
† धी धी, i. 4, Ātm. (properly pass. of धा), To hold, to disregard, or to accomplish.

धी धी, (vb. ध्यै), f.
 1. Knowledge, Bhāṣāp. 45; Man. 6, 92.
 2. Intellect, mind, Man. 12, 122.
 3. Devotion, Chr. 293, 4 = Rigv. i. 88, 4.
 --Comp.
